To compete in the intelligence era, nations need AI factory infrastructure. Together, @official_naver, NVIDIA, and @Brookfield are expanding Korea’s national AI factory buildout to fuel Korea’s startups and industries at gigawatt-scale. NAVER is deploying the NVIDIA DSX platform to deliver full-stack, lowest-cost AI factory infrastructure.

SK Group and NVIDIA today announced a $500 billion-plus initiative spanning AI factories and next-generation memory. ➡️ @SKtelecom is building a 2-gigawatt NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory in Korea to serve global compute demand. ➡️ @SKhynix and NVIDIA will codevelop next-generation AI memory, including HBM. Korea is ready to become a global AI powerhouse with world-class networks and data centers
